steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: This topic covers key vocabulary and structures for tenses: future and conditional. You need to know the topic vocabulary, be able to use it in all four skills (listening, speaking, reading, writing), and express opinions with reasons. | GCSE Spanish Exam Tips: Use the future tense for plans and predictions. Use the conditional for hypothetical situations, polite requests and advice. Use ir a + infinitive for near future. Know the irregular future/conditional stems.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Write 4 sentences in Spanish about tenses: future and conditional. | Write a paragraph (40-60 words) giving your opinion on tenses: future and conditional. | Translate into Spanish: "I think tenses: future and conditional is important because..."
